law.law: Constitution of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste, Section 15
Law No. 2/2007 on National Symbols, Articles 3 and 4

meta.name: Timor-Leste
note: The constitution gives the triangles and the star's place and direction, but no proportion or star size.

The 1:2 proportion and the star's size are from the technical note of the UNTAET Independence Day committee of May 2002, as reported on FOTW, which isn't a law. FOTW reports that 2:3 flags are also used officially.

Law 2/2007 refers to the constitution for the design, and to an official picture in its Annex A. The copy read lacks that annex. FOTW describes it as a crude picture of about 7:12, and Wikipedia reports it as 1:2.
Pantone 123 and 485 are from the same UNTAET note. The hex values are Flag Color Codes', and aren't official. The constitution names only the colors.
